subject: Scheduling: ACME evaluation kickoff / trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>, Elena Torres <elena@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME - next steps & evaluation kickoff

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to hear more about ACME's content-summary and support automation priorities. Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Goal: run a short evaluation (2-4 week) focused on reducing average ticket triage time and improving summary fidelity on multi-paragraph support threads.
- Success criteria (proposal): 20% reduction in triage median latency OR 15% lift in summary ROUGE/ROUGE-L on a held-out prompt set. We can finalize metrics in the kickoff.
- Proposed next step: evaluation kickoff call (30-45m) to agree on trial plan, dataset/prompt set, and success criteria; we can also cover technical requirements and calendar/VM access.

I'm attaching a short eval plan & checklist (redwood-eval-plan.pdf) with an initial timeline and owner assignments. Can you share 30-45m windows next week? My slots: Tue 6/29 10-12 PT, Wed 6/30 9-11 PT, Thu 7/1 1-4 PT.

If easier, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/30min

Thanks — looking forward to getting the trial setup.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: redwood-eval-plan.pdf (6 pages)
From: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - next steps & evaluation kickoff

Thanks Marissa — that recap lines up with our needs. Appreciate the proposed success criteria; two quick asks before we lock time:

1) Can you confirm what the "prompt set" will look like? We'll want a small representative sample (50-100 tickets) plus rules for holdout selection.
2) Who from your side should join the technical deep dive? We'll bring a solutions engineer and our infra lead.

My availability next week: Tue 6/29 after 11:30 PT, Wed 6/30 9-10 PT, Thu 7/1 2-3 PT. Elena is copied and can confirm.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Product Manager | ACME Corp
samir@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acme.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - next steps & evaluation kickoff

Samir — thanks. Quick answers below and a few action items.

- Prompt set: we'll start with a ~75-ticket representative seed (mixed channels, multi-paragraph threads, varying lengths). We'll share the sampling rules and a CSV of IDs for your team to review prior to kickoff.
- Technical attendees: Connor (solutions engineering) will lead the runtime/access/ingestion discussion; I will run the success-criteria and rollout plan. Recommend your SE and infra lead join.

Proposed kickoff times (I can set the calendar once you confirm):
- Wed 6/30 09:30-10:00 PT (30m)
- Thu 7/1 14:00-14:45 PT (45m)

Attached: eval-checklist.xlsx (owners + preliminary timeline).

Action items:
- Samir: confirm which of the two slots works for ACME + confirm attendees (SE name + infra lead email).
- Marissa: send calendar invite + pre-kickoff materials (prompt sample, sampling rules, shared Drive link).
- Connor: prepare short infra checklist (ingestion paths, VPN/KMS questions).

If those times don't work, we can pivot — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Marissa
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - next steps & evaluation kickoff

Looping in a couple of notes from the infra side:

- For the eval we typically do S3 signed uploads or a secure SharePoint/Drive transfer. If you have an internal ingestion pipeline we can take a small sample via SFTP.
- VPN access isn't required for the seed prompt set; we will need a service account or short-lived credentials if you want automated ingestion. I'll bring a short checklist to the kickoff.
- I'll also cover quantization/model recommendations for latency/cost tradeoffs during the technical deep dive.

Thanks — I can join either slot Marissa proposed.

Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
From: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - next steps & evaluation kickoff

Thanks everyone — Thu 7/1 14:00-14:45 PT works for us. Attendees: Samir Shah (PM), Elena Torres (Engineering Manager), Miguel Perez (Infra lead - miguel.perez@acme.com), and our SE Priya Rao (priya.rao@acme.com).

We also confirmed the success metric preference internally: prioritize summary fidelity on the held-out set (ROUGE-L improvement); if we hit >15% we consider the test successful.

Marissa — can you send the calendar invite + Drive folder and the prompt sample CSV? We'll aim to review the sample before the call.

Best,
Samir
